newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Aug palm oil exports 708,601 tonnes - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Aug palm oil exports 708,601 tonnes - SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor, Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said on Monday it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for August at 708,601 tonnes compared with 649,331 tonnes in July.
It said the exports comprised 184,836 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 294,055 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 75,737 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products accounted for 153,973 tonnes.
India was the top buyer in August, taking 151,737 tonnes followed by Pakistan which bought 129,661 tonnes, China 51,275 tonnes and Japan 41,340 tonnes.
Countries in the European Union bought 87,625 tonnes while Middle East countries took 51,100 tonnes.
